x: Of the Eleventh Plan's total outlay (Rs 36,44,718 crore, Centre + States), energy got Rs 8,54,123 crore (23.4%), the most of any single head. Education got about Rs 3.76 lakh crore (Centre Rs 2,74,228 crore + States Rs 1,01,933 crore). Education's famous 19.3% is its share of the Centre's budget support only (official key: Education).
source: Eleventh Five Year Plan Vol I Table 3.13 and State-wise table (education); MoSPI Statistical Year Book "Five Year Plan" write-up (energy 23.43%)
dispute: Most books and the official key give Education (the Eleventh Plan is called the 'Education Plan'; education got 19.3% of the Centre's Gross Budgetary Support). Strictly, of the total Eleventh Plan outlay energy got more (Rs 8.54 lakh crore vs about Rs 3.76 lakh crore).
